name: Lindsey Williams
title: Advanced Practice Provider
bio: Lindsey graduated with a degree in respiratory therapy in 2018 and worked in emergency and critical care as a respiratory therapist until she transitioned to nursing in 2022. As a registered nurse, she worked in endoscopy and specialty clinics while pursuing her master's degree at Emory University. Having spent most of her life in Atlanta, she lived in Seattle for 2 years before making Denver her home in 2024. Outside of work, she enjoys reading, running, biking, and spending time with her boyfriend and pets.
